steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as a single-stage reverse auction.
Apply a buy/reverse-auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested product as the first line with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publishing.

args.goal: on the single-stage create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes set to None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the terms configuration

steps.note: Configure the two optional clauses, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one QA vendor for the bid.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing round as the vendor.
Verify the vendor bid screen contains the Terms & Conditions block.
Submit a quote of 100 for every line without accepting any mandatory clause.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Verify the buyer sees the vendor response.
